summary: Frontend-only E2E regression for the Office 'Generate Proposed Sketch' surface after the shared-core gable axis-semantics guard change. Both target flows pass end-to-end with no runtime/console errors. GenRectHC (high-confidence, single rectangular plane): [data-testid=generate-proposed-btn] visible on empty sketch; clicking opens [data-testid=generate-proposal-panel] with [data-testid=generate-readiness]='High confidence'; [data-testid=generate-cancel-btn] restores empty state and re-shows the generate button; re-open + [data-testid=generate-use-btn] adopts the proposal as an unsaved edit ([data-testid=save-state-badge] becomes 'Unsaved changes'). GenNeedsReview (two facets sharing a valley): generate-proposed-btn visible; readiness='Needs review'; [data-testid=generate-ambiguity]='F2 placement needs review — measurements establish a Valley with F1 but do not uniquely establish which side of F1.'; generate-use-btn present and correctly disabled (no drawable geometry). Confirms the packages/roof-sketch-core/generateSketchGeometry.js axis-guard change did not regress the bundled Office UI path.
critical_code_review_comments: RoofSketchEditor.jsx: generate-proposed-btn is only rendered when save.serverVersion == null && isEmptyDoc && !proposal (line 105/303). Regression-testing this surface requires a truly empty+unsaved sketch. Prior test runs (63-65) persisted sketches for GenRectHC/GenNeedsReview under revision 8fa662ee, which made the seeded 'high-confidence rectangular plane' and 'needs-review' cases fall into the regenerate-proposed-btn path instead of generate-proposed-btn. To exercise the requested code path this iteration deleted the two measurement_sketch_documents rows for that revision (see seed_data_creation). Recommend the seed lifecycle either (a) leave the target structures empty/unsaved for Rev 2 Draft, or (b) provide an editor-level Delete/Reset-sketch control (there is none today) so QA does not need direct DB access.
seed_data_creation: Reset persisted sketches by executing: DELETE FROM measurement_sketch_documents WHERE revision_id='8fa662ee-cc1b-4472-8002-dfa33ed8abdc' AND structure_id IN ('93da54e6-c8f7-4c8b-91ce-decb035c41d4','651dc22a-d168-4e78-9060-e31c87cf0fd8'); (2 rows deleted). This restored the empty+unsaved state required for the generate-proposed-btn code path. After the HC test, GenRectHC now has an in-editor unsaved proposal (not saved).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Rev 2 Draft on lead e7b41ad7-cc50-4a56-ae70-30558c974c4a. To open a specific structure's sketch, locate the input whose .value === structure name (e.g., 'GenRectHC' or 'GenNeedsReview'), then walk up the DOM and click the sibling button whose text matches /Sketch Roof|Edit Roof Sketch/. To exercise generate-proposed-btn (empty+unsaved path) the measurement_sketch_documents rows for the target structures must be absent — otherwise you fall into the regenerate-proposed-btn path. HC rectangle renders as 40 LF (ridge/eave-parallel) × ~19 LF (eave→ridge horizontal projection) at 4/12; measurement is 20×40 (Ridge/Length=40, Width=20). NR ambiguity string is stable: 'F2 placement needs review — measurements establish a Valley with F1 but do not uniquely establish which side of F1.'
rca of the issue: No regression observed. The gable axis-semantics guard in packages/roof-sketch-core/generateSketchGeometry.js is functioning end-to-end through the Office bundle: (a) the shed/rectangular HC case still yields readiness=high_confidence and a drawable rectangle with ridge/eave-parallel=40 and eave-perpendicular width=20 projected on canvas; (b) the two-facet valley case correctly surfaces readiness=needs_review with the F2-placement ambiguity and a disabled Use Proposed button.
